                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  <!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head>


<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Inside Dandy — The first AI dental lab</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&amp;display=swap">
<template id="__bundler_thumbnail">
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
  <rect width="200" height="200" fill="#001814"></rect>
  <circle cx="100" cy="115" r="44" fill="none" stroke="#C7E738" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2 4"></circle>
  <circle cx="100" cy="115" r="26" fill="#C7E738" opacity="0.8"></circle>
  <text x="100" y="80" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-family="Georgia,serif" font-size="22" font-style="italic">AI</text>
</svg>
</template>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:'Bagoss Standard';src:url('data:font/woff2;base64,') format('woff2'),local('Bagoss Standard');font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}

:root{
  --teal:#003A30;
  --teal-deep:#001814;
  --teal-900:#00271F;
  --cit:#C7E738;
  --green:#1AC065;
  --green-d:#16A356;
  --gray:#1E1E1D;
  --paper:#FDFCFA;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  --display:'Bagoss Standard','PT Serif',Georgia,serif;
  --body:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
  --ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
}

*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:var(--body);
  background:var(--teal-deep);
  color:#fff;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
em.ai{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400}
.eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.27em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cit)}

/* ─────────── PROGRESS / NAV ─────────── */
.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);z-index:100}
.progress::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:var(--p,0%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),var(--cit));transition:width 80ms linear}

nav.top{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:90;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:20px 40px;
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(140%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(140%);
  background:rgba(0,24,20,0);
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  transition:background 400ms var(--ease),border-color 400ms var(--ease),padding 400ms var(--ease);
}
nav.top.scrolled{background:rgba(0,24,20,0.72);border-bottom-color:var(--line);padding:14px 40px}
nav.top .logo{font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-0.03em;line-height:1;color:#fff}
nav.top .logo .ai{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}
nav.top .links{display:flex;gap:32px;align-items:center}
nav.top .links a{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;transition:color 200ms}
nav.top .links a:hover{color:var(--cit)}
nav.top .nav-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
nav.top .tiny{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);font-family:var(--body);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background 200ms var(--ease),color 200ms,border-color 200ms}
nav.top .tiny:hover{background:rgba(199,231,56,0.12);color:var(--cit);border-color:rgba(199,231,56,0.4)}
nav.top .tiny.ok{background:var(--cit);color:var(--teal);border-color:var(--cit)}
nav.top .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--cit);color:var(--teal);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:0.02em;transition:transform 200ms var(--ease),background 200ms;cursor:pointer}
nav.top .pill:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-1px)}

/* ─────────── HERO ─────────── */
.hero{
  position:relative;height:100vh;min-height:780px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;background:var(--teal-deep);
}
.hero .bg-photo{
  position:absolute;inset:-5%;
  background-image:url('data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAD/ACwAAAAAAQABAAACADs=');
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  opacity:0;
  transform:scale(1.15);
  transition:opacity 1800ms var(--ease-out),transform 16000ms linear;
  filter:saturate(0.55) contrast(1.05);
}
.hero.ready .bg-photo{opacity:0.32;transform:scale(1.0)}
.hero .bg-overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 70%,rgba(0,58,48,0.4) 0%,rgba(0,24,20,0.92) 60%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,24,20,0.6) 0%,rgba(0,24,20,0.3) 40%,rgba(0,24,20,0.95) 100%);
  z-index:2;
}
.hero .grid-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right,rgba(199,231,56,0.04) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(199,231,56,0.04) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:80px 80px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,black 0%,transparent 80%);
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,black 0%,transparent 80%);
  z-index:3;
}
.hero .signal-orb{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0.6);
  width:1100px;height:1100px;border-radius:50%;
  z-index:3;pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;
  transition:opacity 2000ms 400ms var(--ease-out),transform 2400ms 200ms var(--ease-out);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(199,231,56,0) 30%,rgba(199,231,56,0.06) 30.5%,rgba(199,231,56,0.06) 31%,rgba(199,231,56,0) 31%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(199,231,56,0) 42%,rgba(199,231,56,0.10) 42%,rgba(199,231,56,0.10) 42.4%,rgba(199,231,56,0) 42.4%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 56%,rgba(255,255,255,0.07) 56%,rgba(255,255,255,0.07) 56.3%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 56.3%);
}
.hero.ready .signal-orb{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}
.hero .signal-orb::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:18%;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,rgba(26,192,101,0.18),rgba(26,192,101,0) 70%);
  filter:blur(40px);
  animation:pulse 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse{
  0%,100%{opacity:0.6;transform:scale(1)}
  50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.05)}
}

.hero .content{
  position:relative;z-index:10;text-align:center;
  max-width:1100px;padding:0 40px;
}
.hero .eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:32px;
  padding:8px 18px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity 1000ms 100ms var(--ease-out),transform 1000ms 100ms var(--ease-out);
}
.hero .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cit);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--cit)}
.hero.ready .eyebrow{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

.hero h1{
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;
  font-size:clamp(56px,9vw,156px);
  line-height:0.94;letter-spacing:-0.028em;
  color:#fff;
}
.hero h1 .line{
  display:block;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero h1 .line span{
  display:block;
  transform:translateY(110%);
  transition:transform 1100ms var(--ease-out);
}
.hero.ready h1 .line:nth-child(1) span{transform:translateY(0);transition-delay:200ms}
.hero.ready h1 .line:nth-child(2) span{transform:translateY(0);transition-delay:340ms}
.hero.ready h1 .line:nth-child(3) span{transform:translateY(0);transition-delay:480ms}

.hero .lead{
  font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,21px);line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
  max-width:640px;margin:36px auto 48px;font-weight:300;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity 1100ms 720ms var(--ease-out),transform 1100ms 720ms var(--ease-out);
}
.hero.ready .lead{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

.hero .ctas{
  display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity 1100ms 880ms var(--ease-out),transform 1100ms 880ms var(--ease-out);
}
.hero.ready .ctas{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;
  font-size:14px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.02em;
  text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;border:none;
  transition:transform 250ms var(--ease),background 250ms,color 250ms;
}
.btn.primary{background:var(--cit);color:var(--teal)}
.btn.primary:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn.ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);color:#fff;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn .arrow{transition:transform 250ms var(--ease)}
.btn:hover .arrow{transform:translateX(4px)}

.hero .scroll-hint{
  position:absolute;bottom:32px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:10;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity 1500ms 1400ms var(--ease-out);
}
.hero.ready .scroll-hint{opacity:1}
.hero .scroll-hint .line{width:1px;height:48px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,var(--cit),transparent);animation:scrollLine 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes scrollLine{
  0%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}
  50%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:top}
  51%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:bottom}
  100%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom}
}

/* ─────────── MARQUEE ─────────── */
.marquee{
  position:relative;
  background:var(--teal-deep);
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:28px 0;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.marquee .track{
  display:flex;gap:80px;
  white-space:nowrap;
  animation:marquee 40s linear infinite;
  font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
}
.marquee .track .item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:80px}
.marquee .track .item::after{content:"·";color:var(--cit);margin-left:80px}
.marquee .track em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}
@keyframes marquee{
  to{transform:translateX(-50%)}
}

/* ─────────── INTRO STATEMENT ─────────── */
.intro{
  padding:200px 40px;
  background:var(--teal-deep);
  position:relative;
}
.intro .inner{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.intro .eyebrow{margin-bottom:48px}
.intro h2{
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;
  font-size:clamp(40px,5.6vw,84px);
  line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-0.018em;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  max-width:18ch;
}
.intro h2 .word{transition:color 600ms var(--ease)}
.intro h2 .word.lit{color:#fff}
.intro h2 em{font-style:italic;font-family:var(--display)}
.intro h2 .word.lit em.ai{color:var(--cit)}

/* ─────────── SCROLL CINEMA — sticky pillars ─────────── */
.cinema{position:relative;background:var(--teal-deep)}
.cinema-sticky{
  position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;
}
.cinema-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  transition:background 1200ms var(--ease);
}
.cinema-bg.scan{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 60%,#0A4A3E 0%,#001814 70%)}
.cinema-bg.design{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#003A30 0%,#001814 100%)}
.cinema-bg.make{background:#001814}
.cinema-bg.data{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 40%,#0A4A3E 0%,#001814 70%)}

.cinema-art{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  z-index:2;
}
.cinema-art .layer{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;transform:scale(1.05);
  transition:opacity 900ms var(--ease),transform 1400ms var(--ease);
}
.cinema-art .layer.active{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}

/* SCAN — radial dots */
.art-scan{position:relative;width:600px;height:600px}
.art-scan .core{
  position:absolute;inset:30%;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(199,231,56,0.4),rgba(199,231,56,0) 70%);
  filter:blur(20px);
  animation:pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.art-scan .ring{
  position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px dashed rgba(199,231,56,0.3);
  animation:rotate 30s linear infinite;
}
.art-scan .ring.r2{inset:15%;animation-duration:24s;animation-direction:reverse;border-color:rgba(199,231,56,0.5)}
.art-scan .ring.r3{inset:32%;animation-duration:18s;border-color:rgba(199,231,56,0.7)}
.art-scan .dots{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle,var(--cit) 1.6px,transparent 2px);
  background-size:18px 18px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,black 30%,transparent 60%);
          mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,black 30%,transparent 60%);
  animation:rotate 60s linear infinite reverse;
}
@keyframes rotate{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* DESIGN — wireframe */
.art-design{position:relative;width:680px;height:480px}
.art-design svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.art-design .grid-floor{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right,rgba(199,231,56,0.12) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(199,231,56,0.12) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:40px 40px;
  transform:perspective(800px) rotateX(60deg) translateY(120px);
  transform-origin:center center;
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,black 60%,transparent 100%);
          mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,black 60%,transparent 100%);
}

/* MAKE — robotic line */
.art-make{position:relative;width:90vw;max-width:1400px;height:400px}
.art-make .rail{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,var(--cit) 20%,var(--cit) 80%,transparent 100%);
  opacity:0.6;
}
.art-make .node{
  position:absolute;top:50%;width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(199,231,56,0.4);
  background:rgba(199,231,56,0.05);
  transform:translateY(-50%);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.art-make .node::before{
  content:"";width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cit);
  box-shadow:0 0 24px var(--cit);
  animation:nodePulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.art-make .node:nth-child(2){left:8%}
.art-make .node:nth-child(3){left:30%;animation-delay:0.3s}
.art-make .node:nth-child(4){left:52%;animation-delay:0.6s}
.art-make .node:nth-child(5){left:74%;animation-delay:0.9s}
.art-make .node:nth-child(6){left:92%;animation-delay:1.2s}
@keyframes nodePulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(0.8);opacity:0.7}50%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.art-make .traveler{
  position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--cit),rgba(199,231,56,0));
  filter:blur(2px);
  animation:travel 6s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes travel{
  0%{left:0%;opacity:0}
  10%{opacity:1}
  90%{opacity:1}
  100%{left:100%;opacity:0}
}

/* DATA — chart */
.art-data{position:relative;width:760px;height:480px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);align-items:end;gap:8px;padding:0 20px}
.art-data .bar{
  background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--green) 0%,var(--cit) 100%);
  border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;
  opacity:0.85;
  animation:barRise 1.4s var(--ease) backwards;
}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(1){height:30%;animation-delay:0.05s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(2){height:48%;animation-delay:0.1s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(3){height:38%;animation-delay:0.15s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(4){height:62%;animation-delay:0.2s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(5){height:55%;animation-delay:0.25s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(6){height:74%;animation-delay:0.3s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(7){height:68%;animation-delay:0.35s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(8){height:82%;animation-delay:0.4s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(9){height:78%;animation-delay:0.45s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(10){height:92%;animation-delay:0.5s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(11){height:88%;animation-delay:0.55s}
.art-data .bar:nth-child(12){height:100%;animation-delay:0.6s}
@keyframes barRise{from{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom;opacity:0}to{transform:scaleY(1);opacity:0.85}}

.cinema-text{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;top:0;
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;
  padding:0 60px 80px;
  z-index:5;pointer-events:none;
}
.cinema-text .panel{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:80px 60px;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);
  transition:opacity 800ms var(--ease),transform 800ms var(--ease);
}
.cinema-text .panel.active{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.cinema-text .meta{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;width:100%;gap:60px;
}
.cinema-text .num{
  font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(96px,18vw,260px);line-height:0.85;
  letter-spacing:-0.04em;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  font-feature-settings:"tnum";
}
.cinema-text .num em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit);opacity:0.4}
.cinema-text .right{max-width:520px;text-align:right}
.cinema-text .right .label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.27em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cit);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:16px}
.cinema-text .right h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(40px,4.4vw,68px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-0.018em;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:18px}
.cinema-text .right h3 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}
.cinema-text .right p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);font-weight:300}

/* sentinels for scroll-based switching */
.cinema-spacer{height:100vh}

.cinema-stepper{
  position:absolute;left:60px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;
  z-index:8;
}
.cinema-stepper .step{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
  font-weight:500;
  transition:color 400ms var(--ease);
}
.cinema-stepper .step .dot{
  width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  transition:background 400ms var(--ease),transform 400ms var(--ease);
}
.cinema-stepper .step.active{color:#fff}
.cinema-stepper .step.active .dot{background:var(--cit);transform:scale(1.4);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--cit)}

/* ─────────── PARALLAX SHOWCASE ─────────── */
.showcase{
  position:relative;background:var(--teal-deep);
  padding:200px 0 240px;overflow:hidden;
}
.showcase .head{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto 120px;padding:0 40px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr;gap:80px;align-items:end}
.showcase .head .eyebrow{margin-bottom:24px}
.showcase .head h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,76px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-0.018em;color:#fff}
.showcase .head h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}
.showcase .head p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.55;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);max-width:50ch;font-weight:300;align-self:end}

.showcase .stack{position:relative;max-width:1480px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
.showcase .frame{
  position:relative;margin:48px auto;
  border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 60px 120px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}
.showcase .frame.f1{max-width:1100px;aspect-ratio:16/9}
.showcase .frame.f2{max-width:520px;aspect-ratio:3/4;margin-left:auto;margin-right:8%;margin-top:-180px;z-index:3}
.showcase .frame.f3{max-width:920px;aspect-ratio:16/10;margin-left:6%;margin-top:-100px;z-index:2}

.showcase .frame .img{
  position:absolute;inset:-10%;
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  will-change:transform;
}
.showcase .frame.f1 .img{background-image:url('data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAD/ACwAAAAAAQABAAACADs=')}
.showcase .frame.f2 .img{background-image:url('data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAD/ACwAAAAAAQABAAACADs=')}
.showcase .frame.f3 .img{background-image:url('data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAD/ACwAAAAAAQABAAACADs=')}
.showcase .frame .vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,24,20,0) 0%,rgba(0,24,20,0.6) 100%)}
.showcase .frame .caption{
  position:absolute;left:32px;bottom:28px;right:32px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;
  z-index:3;
}
.showcase .frame .caption .label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cit);font-weight:500}
.showcase .frame .caption .where{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);font-weight:500}
.showcase .frame .caption h4{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,44px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-0.012em;color:#fff;font-weight:400;max-width:18ch;margin-top:12px}
.showcase .frame .caption h4 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}

/* ─────────── STATS BAR ─────────── */
.stats{
  position:relative;
  padding:160px 40px;background:var(--teal-deep);
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);
}
.stats::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(199,231,56,0.06) 1px,transparent 1.4px);
  background-size:32px 32px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,black 0%,transparent 70%);
          mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,black 0%,transparent 70%);
}
.stats .inner{position:relative;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px}
.stats .stat{
  padding:48px 32px;
  border-left:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  min-height:280px;
}
.stats .stat:first-child{border-left:none}
.stats .stat .num{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(56px,5.6vw,96px);line-height:0.95;letter-spacing:-0.025em;color:#fff;font-feature-settings:"tnum"}
.stats .stat .num em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}
.stats .stat .label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);margin-top:18px;font-weight:500}
.stats .stat .desc{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);margin-top:8px;font-weight:300}

/* ─────────── INVITATION ─────────── */
.invite{
  position:relative;background:var(--teal);
  padding:200px 40px 220px;overflow:hidden;
}
.invite::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:140vh;height:140vh;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(199,231,56,0.10) 0%,rgba(199,231,56,0) 60%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.invite::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:radial-gradient(circle,var(--cit) 1.3px,transparent 1.8px);
  background-size:18px 18px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 80%,black 0%,black 12%,transparent 50%);
          mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 80%,black 0%,black 12%,transparent 50%);
  opacity:0.5;
}
.invite .inner{position:relative;max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;z-index:2}
.invite .eyebrow{margin-bottom:36px}
.invite h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(48px,8vw,128px);line-height:0.96;letter-spacing:-0.025em;color:#fff;margin-bottom:32px}
.invite h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}
.invite p{font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,20px);line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78);max-width:580px;margin:0 auto 48px;font-weight:300}
.invite .ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.invite .meta-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:48px;margin-top:96px;padding-top:36px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap}
.invite .meta-row .item{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);font-weight:500}
.invite .meta-row .item b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:var(--cit);font-weight:400;text-transform:none;margin-bottom:6px}

/* ─────────── FOOTER ─────────── */
footer{background:var(--teal-deep);padding:64px 40px 40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
footer .inner{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px}
footer .logo{font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-0.03em}
footer .logo em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cit)}
footer .links{display:flex;gap:32px;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);letter-spacing:0.05em}
footer .links a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:color 200ms}
footer .links a:hover{color:var(--cit)}
footer .copy{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35);letter-spacing:0.1em}

/* reveal helper */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px);transition:opacity 1000ms var(--ease-out),transform 1000ms var(--ease-out)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}

@media (max-width:980px){
  nav.top .links{display:none}
  .showcase .head{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .stats .inner{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .stats .stat{border-left:none;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:32px 0}
  .cinema-text .meta{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:24px}
  .cinema-text .right{text-align:left}
  .cinema-stepper{display:none}
}
</style>

<script>
(() => {
  // mark hero ready on load (next frame for transitions)
  const hero = document.getElementById('hero');
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => hero.classList.add('ready')));

  // sticky nav
  const nav = document.getElementById('topnav');
  const onScrollNav = () => nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 40);
  onScrollNav();
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollNav, {passive:true});

  // progress bar
  const progress = document.querySelector('.progress');
  const onProgress = () => {
    const sH = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
    const p = sH > 0 ? (window.scrollY / sH) * 100 : 0;
    progress.style.setProperty('--p', p + '%');
  };
  onProgress();
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onProgress, {passive:true});

  // intro statement — light up words on scroll
  const introWords = document.querySelectorAll('#introStatement .word');
  const introH2 = document.getElementById('introStatement');
  const onIntro = () => {
    if (!introH2) return;
    const r = introH2.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vh = window.innerHeight;
    // start when top of h2 hits 70% of viewport, end when bottom hits 30%
    const start = vh * 0.85;
    const end = vh * 0.25;
    const total = r.height + (start - end);
    const traveled = Math.max(0, Math.min(total, start - r.top));
    const ratio = traveled / total;
    const lit = Math.floor(ratio * introWords.length);
    introWords.forEach((w, i) => w.classList.toggle('lit', i < lit));
  };
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onIntro, {passive:true});
  onIntro();

  // cinema sticky — switch panel based on which spacer is in view
  const spacers = document.querySelectorAll('.cinema-spacer');
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.cinema-text .panel');
  const arts = document.querySelectorAll('.cinema-art .layer');
  const steps = document.querySelectorAll('.cinema-stepper .step');
  const cinemaBg = document.getElementById('cinemaBg');
  const bgClasses = ['scan','design','make','data'];
  let currentCine = 0;
  const setCine = (i) => {
    if (i === currentCine) return;
    currentCine = i;
    panels.forEach((p, idx) => p.classList.toggle('active', idx === i));
    arts.forEach((a, idx) => a.classList.toggle('active', idx === i));
    steps.forEach((s, idx) => s.classList.toggle('active', idx === i));
    cinemaBg.className = 'cinema-bg ' + bgClasses[i];
  };
  const onCine = () => {
    const vh = window.innerHeight;
    let active = 0;
    spacers.forEach((sp, i) => {
      const r = sp.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.top < vh * 0.5 && r.bottom > vh * 0.5) active = i;
    });
    setCine(active);
  };
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onCine, {passive:true});
  onCine();

  // parallax frames
  const parallax = document.querySelectorAll('[data-parallax]');
  const onParallax = () => {
    parallax.forEach(el => {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const vh = window.innerHeight;
      if (r.bottom < 0 || r.top > vh) return;
      const speed = parseFloat(el.dataset.parallax);
      const center = r.top + r.height / 2;
      const offset = (center - vh / 2) * speed;
      el.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${-offset}px, 0)`;
    });
  };
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onParallax, {passive:true});
  onParallax();

  // reveals
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('in');
        io.unobserve(e.target);
        if (e.target.matches('.stat')) animateStat(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold:0.18});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => io.observe(el));

  // count up
  const animateStat = (stat) => {
    const numEl = stat.querySelector('.num');
    if (!numEl) return;
    const target = parseFloat(numEl.dataset.count);
    const prefix = numEl.dataset.prefix || '';
    const suffix = numEl.dataset.suffix || '';
    const duration = 1600;
    const start = performance.now();
    const isFloat = String(target).includes('.');
    const tick = (t) => {
      const el = Math.min(1, (t - start) / duration);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - el, 4);
      const val = target * eased;
      const display = isFloat ? val.toFixed(1) : Math.round(val);
      numEl.innerHTML = `${prefix}<em>${display}</em>${suffix}`;
      if (el < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  // copy HTML button
  const copyBtn = document.getElementById('copyHtmlBtn');
  if (copyBtn) {
    copyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const html = '<!doctype html>\n' + document.documentElement.outerHTML;
      const flash = (txt) => {
        const orig = copyBtn.textContent;
        copyBtn.textContent = txt;
        copyBtn.classList.add('ok');
        setTimeout(() => { copyBtn.textContent = orig; copyBtn.classList.remove('ok'); }, 1800);
      };
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(html);
        flash('Copied ✓');
      } catch (e) {
        // fallback — trigger download
        const blob = new Blob([html], {type:'text/html'});
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url; a.download = 'inside-dandy.html';
        document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        flash('Downloaded ✓');
      }
    });
  }
})();
</script>
